title: Elements at Water Street

services.name: Corporate Events
services.desc: Naperville has many options when it comes to space for holding your next company meeting or outing. Elements was designed to offer a unique and convenient space right in the heart of downtown Naperville. Elements river front location occupies the entire 2nd floor of the stunning Hotel Indigo and offers private boardroom and meeting space from 10 to 100 people, separate break house hospitality space and ballroom seating capacity for 230 guests. Chicagoland's premier event venue located in the heart of historic downtown
